newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chad's Deby meets France's Juppe on private visit.
newsitem.headline: Chad's Deby meets France's Juppe on private visit.

text.p: Chad President Idriss Deby, on a private visit to France, met French Prime Minister Alain Juppe on Monday for talks covering aid, human rights and military cooperation.

"The fact that I am on a private visit doesn't prevent a meeting with French authorities given the links there are between France and Chad, the cooperation which exists in all domains," Deby told reporters after meeting Juppe.
Deby, who met French President Jacques Chirac on Saturday, said he and Juppe discussed economic development projects and military cooperation.

Commenting on a report published by rights group Amnesty International last week, Deby said there had been problems affecting human rights but these were due to the legacy of clan wars, the availability of arms and an armed rebellion.
